---
title: "New York Weather Explorer"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---
```{r setup,include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)
data("ny_noaa")

weather = 
  ny_noaa |>
  filter(id == "USW00094728")|>
  mutate(tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
         tmin = as.numeric(tmin)/10,
         prcp = as.numeric(prcp)/10)

yearly_temp = 
  weather|>
  mutate(year = lubridate::year(date))|>
  group_by(year)|>
  summarise(
    avg_tmax = mean(tmax, na.rm = T),
    avg_tmin = mean(tmin, na.rm = T),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

set.seed(100)

tmax_tmin=
  weather|>
  filter(!is.na(tmin), !is.na(tmax))|>
  slice_sample(n = 1000)

monthly_prcp = 
  weather|>
  mutate(year = lubridate::year(date),
         month = lubridate::month(date, label = T))|>
  group_by(year, month)|>
  summarize(
    total_prcp = sum(prcp, na.rm = T),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

monthly_prcp_avg = 
  monthly_prcp|>
  group_by(month)|>
  summarise(
    avg_monthly_prcp = mean(total_prcp),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Yearly average temperature
```{r, echo=FALSE}
plot_ly(data = yearly_temp,
  x = ~year
)|>
  add_lines(
    y = ~avg_tmax,
    name = "Maximum temperature"
  )|>
  layout(
    title = "Yearly average temperature",
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Temperature")
  )
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
### Daily minimum vs maximum temperature
```{r, echo=FALSE}
plot_ly(data = tmax_tmin, 
        x = ~tmin, 
        y = ~tmax, 
        type = "scatter", 
        mode = "markers",
        marker = list(size = 5, opacity = .5))|>
  layout(title = "Daily minimum vs maximum temperature",
         xaxis = list(title = "Minimum temperature"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Maximum temperature"))
```

### Average monthly total percipitation
```{r, echo=FALSE}
plot_ly(
  data = monthly_prcp_avg,
  x = ~month,
  y = ~avg_monthly_prcp,
  type = "bar",
  marker = list(color = "pink")
)|>
  layout(
    title = "Average monthly total precipitation",
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Precipitation")
  )
```
